english translation text: AT THE SIDE OF THE SLAIN KING OF MARTYRS

arabic text: KHWAHAM RAWAM BAR SUYE SHAM, AY BIRADAR JAAN
english translation text: I AM GOING TOWARDS SHAM, O DEAR BROTHER
AT THE SIDE OF THE SLAIN LORD, THE STANDARD-BEARER

arabic text: BIRADAR-E MAN, AH WAWAILA! TAJ-E SAR-E MAN, AH WAWAILA! KHAK BAR SAR-E MAN,
english translation text: O MY BROTHER, WOEFUL FAREWELL! O CROWN OF MY HEAD, WOEFUL FAREWELL! I AM RUINED!

arabic text: BA FUGHAN GUFTA LAYLA BA AKBAR

english translation text: WHERE IS MY YOUNG SON, THE IMAGE OF THE MESSENGER?

arabic text: AY AKBAR-E MAN, AH WAWAILA! TAJ-E SAR-E MAN, AH WAWAILA! KHAK BAR SAR-E MAN,
english translation text: O MY AKBAR, WOEFUL FAREWELL! O CROWN OF MY HEAD, WOEFUL FAREWELL! I AM RUINED!

arabic text: BAR MAN NAZ KUN, TARK SAFAR KUN
english translation text: LOOK AT ME, ABANDON YOUR JOURNEY

arabic text: AZ SHO’LE-YE AAH-E MAN HADHR KUN,
english translation text: BE MINDFUL OF MY CRIES OF BURNING SORROW

arabic text: AARAM-EJANAM, AH WAWAILA! RUH O RAWAANAM, AH WAWAILA! SHAM’-E MAZAARAM.
english translation text: O CONSOLER OF MY HEART, WOEFUL FAREWELL! O (OCCUPIER OF) MY HEART AND MIND, WOEFUL FAREWELL!! O CANDLE ON MY GRAVE.
AT THE SIDE OF THE SLAIN KING OF THE OPPRESSED
